description: Returns the register profile of one German company: name, address, legal form, register court, WZ industry code, website and alive verdict (active/dead/unknown) with the date of the status (as_of). Intended for requests where the user asks who a company is, where it is registered or whether it is still active, and the company_number_norm is known (otherwise find_company resolves it first). Example user questions: 'Wer steckt hinter HRB 52093, Amtsgericht Hamburg?' (key K1101_HRB52093), 'Welche Adresse hat K1101_HRB52093?', 'Is this company still active?' Related: check_company_status checks up to 25 companies at once; get_company_financials returns the financial history.

register.description: company_number_norm — the unique register key for a German company. Format: {CourtLetter}{4digits}_{HRB|HRA|PR|GnR|VR}{Nummer}, Example: 'K1101_HRB52093' is HRB 52093 at Amtsgericht Hamburg (court code K1101). Court codes are not derivable from city names or initials; the key comes from find_company (register number + court, EUID, LEI, VAT ID) or from an earlier firm tool result. Input that is not a key (e.g. 'HRB 52093 Hamburg') is resolved the same way as in find_company; a well-formed key that belongs to no company is answered 'not found' (usually a wrong court code).
